tagline: Explain why a named human can trust an AI-written change.
introduction: Develop a requirement-linked AI review concept and reference illustration for Earned Trust in AI Code. Connect claims to base/head checks, show uncertainty and human-only decisions, and distinguish measured review results from proposed incident/revert proxies.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Tieto? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Map a service workflow
capabilities.description: Map a proposed workflow, with a separate offline helper for fictional RACI, failure-owner, bounded-retry and declared-transfer checks; no execution or permission grant.

capabilities.title: Prepare integration questions
capabilities.description: Identify interfaces, identities and data quality questions before implementation.

capabilities.title: Define a bounded pilot
capabilities.description: Translate a broad transformation idea into a measurable pilot.

capabilities.title: Design Tieto challenge support
capabilities.description: Requirement-linked claim-ledger reviewer. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Discriminating checks on supplied MessagePack base/head branches; unsupported claims route to named human
